scope: 34-page finished-story book. All V28 page PNGs inspected at full rendered resolution; original34-pages on contact sheet plus enlarged original3,5,9,16,21,22,28,31. Reuse-first repo props inspected. No plot or pagination changes.
master_audit_scale_limit: audit/MASTER_AUDIT_2026-08-09.md section 1.1 defines5 as release-proven, including intended-child/owner acceptance. Values below are independent internal craft estimates, not game-master satisfaction or owner/child/SLP acceptance. They retain defects separately and do not close MA findings.

internal_craft_rubric.basis: Qualitative visual estimate across focal hierarchy, event-specific background/prop use, source/style continuity, physical-page type readability and pacing; not a calibrated scientific rating.

anchors.5: Reserved, cannot claim final acceptance from this review
anchors.4.9: Internal visual target: no observed material craft defect at review scale

internal_craft_rubric.limitation: No print proof, professional speech-language review, or observed-child acceptance in this independent review.

original_design_findings.finding: Alternating full art and true contour cutouts
original_design_findings.evidence: Original pages6/8/12/14/17/19/20/23/24/27/30/32 full-art; pages4/5/9/16/21/22/28/31 stationery use transparent figures/props. Current book now honors this distinction.

original_design_findings.finding: Bottom details tell the same event
original_design_findings.evidence: Original16 cooking banks contain egg, whisk and spices;21 craft banks glue, thread, scissors/buttons;28sleep shows Eagle asleep rather than same idle image.
original_design_findings.implication: Current clean-room banks should show relevant actions/props, not repetitive brushes/suds.

original_design_findings.finding: Base is quiet and simple, ornament concentrated low
original_design_findings.evidence: Original pale aqua wash and fine dot perimeter leave story text/figures dominant; decorative shells/coral exist but are varied in soft color.
original_design_findings.implication: Keep blue base and low slopes. Add curated story details, not a panoramic intricate background behind text.

original_design_findings.evidence: Original16 has three cooking action cutouts around middle text;21 table upper and crafts below;28large bed with top caption;31hug with top caption.
original_design_findings.implication: Keep successful current16 side caption; avoid mechanically identical central cutout on every page. Current book's layout rhythm is already substantially improved.

original_design_findings.finding: Dust bunny actors can replace Eagle marginal actions
original_design_findings.evidence: Original28sleeping Eagle and29playful plush details offer model for event-responsive mini acting; owner explicitly asks dustbunnies fill this role in newstory.
original_design_findings.implication: Vary marginal counts0–2 here, different eyelines and pearl-paw actions. Do not duplicate the main illustration props.

original_design_findings.finding: Original is precedent, not perfectly consistent mandatory template
original_design_findings.evidence: Original includes some rectangular secondary contextual image and objects larger than present12%limit.
original_design_findings.implication: Latest owner's explicit full-art/cutout and bounded banks rules control; do not revive older exceptions without request.

rhythm_review.current: Four opening full-art pages establish place, then tool stationery. Bathroom alternates6F/7C/8C/9F; pool10F/11C/12F–15F/16C; rescue17F–19F/20C; craft21C/22F; door23F; Puff24C/25C/26F–29F; reflection30C/play31C/sleep32F.
rhythm_review.judgment: Purposeful cinematic opening and four-page transformation runs can remain. Action-closeups and stationery relief provide pacing. No need to insert/remove pages or invent subplot.
rhythm_review.open: Setting continuity17→18, tangible completed-clean payoff22, and weak full-art typography are more important than redistributing finished story.

bank_constraints: All decorative objects below normalized y=0.85, both width/height<=0.12, low mound grounding through 10% occlusion+soft contact shadow, central gap clear; reserve speaking-character exception already explicitly approved instead of silently declaring compliance.

lamma.current_problem: V28has2 nominal peeks already, but neither reliably communicates unmistakable Lamma at reading size; user says she is absent, so replace these ambiguous peeks rather than stacking extra appearances.

plan.shape: Visible actual face and sideways ears; body/egg concealed by towels.

plan.location: Behind tiny toy chest/toys in left bank
plan.shape: Actual white fluffy head and ears, no generic blue cat face.

lamma.subtlety: About 55–65 pixels visible head at1484x1060 native as a starting point, adjust on page proof. Match cleanRGBA colors; no label, search prompt, repeated icon or arrow.

Source-preserving page 3 detail restoration; no full scene replacement or door geometry changes.
Dirty toy-room/playroom continuity from pages 17 to 18–19.
page 14 necklace/bracelet andpages 18–19 top variation identity repairs.

pages.label: Front cover
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Rendered scene, strong welcome pose and narrative props; title is legible.
open_criteria: Preserve owner-approved composite. Print proof must check title/subtitle trim and fine facial detail.

pages.label: Look through airplane window
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Clear closeup point-of-view establishes destination.
open_criteria: Navy lettering with thin white halo crosses teal metal and window rim; use solid high-contrast type on quiet metal. Keep main facial silhouette and castle view.

pages.label: Sky Lagoon arrival
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Wide source art suits landscape; arrival is unambiguous.
open_criteria: Caption halo unnecessary over bright sky; simplify to solid navy. No foreground people needed if text identifies arrival.

pages.label: Entering dirty castle
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Correct open doors now communicate entry, no source-breaking invented scene.
open_criteria: Soft source density visibly below adjacent pages; bounded source restoration of faces/crown/tail/door edges. Roshan crown is side-profile variant but should retain same turquoise jewel identity. Preserve current door seams/geometry.

pages.label: Dusty castle exploration
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Makes cleaning need and indoor location explicit; dust piles are visible.
open_criteria: Thin outlined text across busy cornice/column loses emphasis. Use quiet-wall caption zone and strong type. Preserve source architecture; theatre icon is not a reason to replace this legitimate hall.

pages.label: Cleaning tools
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Large brush and sponge contour cutouts are clear.
open_criteria: Bank bunny beside generic bucket reads idle; personalize with supply-basket peek and differentiated right soap dish. Never duplicate main brush or sponge in margin.

pages.label: Dirty bath bunny
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Bunny has strong action and pearly paws; green bath grime reads well.
open_criteria: Bottom caption crosses noisy tub/floor textures. Improve text contrast; preserve expressive bunny. Avoid adding extra distracting props to full art.

pages.label: Wiping shell sink
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Main figure and sink form connected contour cutout; wiping contact is visible.
open_criteria: Sink still has green residue, so caption completion needs final-wipe interpretation or local clean-side treatment. Bank has repeat shell/cloth and vague bunny activity; use mirror reflection and folded towel instead.

pages.label: Draining and scrubbing tub
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Dirt and drained bottom make action clear; scale is good.
open_criteria: Yellow duck and rolled towel are relevant but static; one bunny gently pushing duck plus tiny pulled plug can add cause/context. Brush in main art differs from tool page: check canonical prop continuity.

pages.label: Clean bath payoff
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Clean water and repeated room equipment support before/after comprehension.
open_criteria: Current towel-basket Lamma peek reads a small generic round cat face, not clear plush silhouette; replace locally from clean Lamma reference. Caption should be solid contrast over quiet floor.

pages.label: Rumi trapped in gunk
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Net, gunky pool, and Rumi reaching for help tell problem clearly.
open_criteria: Typography bottom over bright pavement needs simplification. Keep strainer in frame; Roshan/Rumi hand contact and trapped depth clear.

pages.label: Scoop rubbish
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Excellent actual trash motif: wrapper, tipped can, cap and gunky net; events agree.
open_criteria: Preserve real rubbish and existing grounding. Main net is richly detailed; avoid adding another net/brush. Rumi's home-time text does not mean she was trapped for centuries.

pages.label: First clear waterfall stream
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Full-resolution image DOES show red/orange left lane clear, remaining lanes green.
open_criteria: Contact-sheet judgment was corrected: not all three blocked. Count/clear-lane geometry could be more unmistakable; preserve action/source identity. Main issue is outlined bottom text over glittery water.

pages.label: Rainbow waterfall
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Strong full-art reveal and rainbow payoff.
open_criteria: Loose rubbish still floats, but streams are clear; ensure wording describes streams, not all pool cleanup done. Improve text contrast; no need invent extra scene action.

pages.label: Seahorse fountain cup
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Cup in Roshan's hands plus flowing spout makes action legible.
open_criteria: Roshan pearl necklace/bracelet appear here but not canonical plain blouse elsewhere; bounded identity repair. Top text over purple texture/column needs quieter patch or solid light type.

pages.label: Rumi rises free
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Clear triumphant release, consistent pool architecture, excellent focal hierarchy.
open_criteria: Bottom type crosses multicolored tile; replace outline-only appearance. Preserve full-art payoff and flowing fountain/waterfall.

pages.label: Rumi hugs Roshan
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Contour hug and asymmetrical left-text/right-art are strong original-book design cues.
open_criteria: Mini seahorse begins too high (~81.9%): lower within bank85% zone. Right bank has only shell/coral; add small event flower/lily cup and one warm-looking bunny, preserving hug.

pages.label: Chirp in dusty toy room
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Dirty source room establishes discovery; dust bunny curiosity has personality.
open_criteria: Severe setting discontinuity: stone dusty toy room becomes bright clean playroom in18 before cleaning. Improve continuity within existing source staging; text over dark floor should be light/solid.

pages.label: Baby Eagle trapped
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Exactly two bunnies pin Eagle; no blanket. Friendly faces soften accidental trouble.
open_criteria: Room appears already clean compared17. Roshan blouse neckline/buttons and front curl/ear topology need identity consistency. Preserve Eagle trapped/contact geometry rather than invent different rescue.

pages.label: Baby Eagle released
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Brush is away from Eagle's face and wing opening clearly communicates release.
open_criteria: Same continuity/top identity concerns as18. Bunny movement is gentle and joyful; preserve small apology scale on next page. Improve floor-caption contrast.

pages.label: Small bunnies apologize
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Right-sized marginal speakers and central Eagle preserve hierarchy.
open_criteria: Speech tails appear attached to ears, capsule footprint too dominant. Tail should point near cheek/body with short gap, different slumped poses. Relevant small toy blocks/rings can supply context; keep bunny sizes small.

pages.label: Sorting messy art supplies
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Best developed stationery page: drippy cups, crumpled art paper, sorting contact and event banks.
open_criteria: Preserve complete main artwork/background unless a measured defect emerges. Text is crisp solid navy. Tipped main cup plus tipped border bottle are different story props, not identical duplication.

pages.label: Clean art room payoff
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Broad quiet wall and recognizable craft room equipment offer good full-art composition.
open_criteria: Explicit text-art contradiction: visible purple paint puddle remains on table while text says table was clean. Remove locally as finishing wipe; retain brush contact and room. Caption outlined over tiles.

pages.label: Last glowing castle door
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Correct castle hall, completed portals, lights directing toward shell door; strong page-turn cue.
open_criteria: Caption spans columns/cornice; quiet lavender wall could support simpler solid navy. Preserve current correct door; do not restore Opera House shot.

pages.label: Dusty uncomfortable Grand Puff
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Sad half-lidded face supports care plot. Two scared bunnies, one under shell, follow explicit owner direction.
open_criteria: Attic books/chest are useful but could look dustier/off-kilter; little bunnies can show more distinct cowering poses. Keep each<= 12%, below 85%; preserve sad Puff.

pages.label: Roshan offers sponge and kindness
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Roshan faces Puff with recognizable pink star sponge and exact caring reassurance.
open_criteria: Mini sofa bunnies currently look victory-celebratory; make hopeful clasped-hands support and visible popcorn nibble. Attic jar/books can show restored/cleaned edge without unrelated toys.

pages.label: All friends wash Puff
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Warm smile and four helpers clarify collaborative care; supplies visibly contact Puff.
open_criteria: Text across ceiling textured bricks needs solid light type/quiet paint zone. Local ceiling join/perspective must stay seamless. Roshan's yellow sponge differs from preceding pink star: choose an explicit consistent prop through bounded repair.

pages.label: Bubbles cover Puff
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Gradual concealment before reveal has suspense without aggression.
open_criteria: Ceiling is noticeably soft/stretched compared actors; repair only ceiling extension without changing room/staging. Bubble fine detail should remain clear rather than granular white compression texture. Caption contrast.

pages.label: Rainbow Puff pops out
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Visible airborne clean Puff and surprised friends give strong transformation payoff.
open_criteria: Ceiling extension and typography same concerns as27; keep clean Puff curl/pearl/ear family matching landing. Dust still on floor is okay as dust falls off him.

pages.label: Canonical rainbow Puff landing
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Exact owner-approved canonical landing, small clean Puff and everyone relieved.
open_criteria: Preserve native landing source completely. Caption/ceiling presentation can be polished without changing scene identity or subject pixels.

pages.label: Roshan and clean Puff reflect
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Calm two-character beat slows story after climax; clear contour figures.
open_criteria: Generic jigsaw bank is less game-specific. Replace with two bunnies cooperatively joining canonical toy rings or blocks; a right-bank clean attic book or lamp adds restored-room meaning. Keep central gap clear and avoid a second rainbow motif.

pages.label: Invitation to gentle play
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Roshan/Eagle warm poses and toy-playing bunnies support friendship conclusion.
open_criteria: Current Lamma looks like blue generic face with ring covering mouth; replace with actual white lamb-plush ears/face peeking naturally from toy chest. Varied bunny ring/boat actions; at most 2 peeks total with9.

pages.label: Everyone sleeps in bubbles
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Excellent emotional ending and group composition, bunnies present, all asleep.
open_criteria: Caption navy/white-outline is weaker than artwork; solid light type on quiet dark wall. Preserve accepted cozy pile; no extra search icon or unnecessary border additions.

pages.label: Rear cover H
pages.score_basis: Observed visual craft estimate, not external acceptance
strengths: Rendered shared scene with all characters and narrative cleanup objects, color style matches book.
open_criteria: Preserve owner-approved H. Rainbow Puff absent may be acceptable rear foreshadowing/context, not a defect requiring new character inventing. Final print proof remains open.
